residualRisks: Sub-30ms clicks during 'go' are classified as false starts (treated as a guess). This is a deliberate product heuristic, not a defect; acceptable.
Tests reuse identical check IDs (false_start_retry x2, five_valid_trials x2, summary x4); duplicates all still surface in failed[], so no pass/fail masking occurs.

The five_valid_trials recovery loop clicks mousedown when the app is stuck in a non-progressing phase, which can mask a genuine state-transition regression; the genuine clean path was independently verified to go->result->next->ready.
No cross-reload settings persistence (localStorage) is implemented; this matches the acceptance test's explicit default-only design, not a hidden requirement.
Validated only under the exact-source Node VM + linkedom partial DOM (no browser/visual rendering); behavior is exercised via handlers and timers, not pixel checks.
